title: Asahina Mafuyu — Nightcord at 25:00〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Mafuyu's Room

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'd like you to take a psychological test.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <What?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <You know that I have someone coming over to do housework for me, right?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I told her that I have a friend who doesn't understand herself, and asked what she thinks might help.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <And she told you I should take a psychological test?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yeah.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I took one too. It was quite fun.
Do you want to try it?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Okay.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Thanks. I'll read it out to you.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <“Imagine you're walking on a beach, alone. The weather is pleasant and the sound of the gentle waves is very soothing.”>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Which beach is it?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I was wondering about that too, but apparently it doesn't matter.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <What's important is that you answer the questions honestly. It's all imaginary, so there's no need to focus on the details.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Okay.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <“You keep walking until you arrive at a small harbor. A single boat is moored there.”>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<“Question one: What size is the boat?
Would it be easy or difficult to get on it?”>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <A boat, huh...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<It's very big and impressive.
You'd need a special invitation to get on it.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<You took this test too?
What was your answer?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <A shabby little boat you can just hop on, but it's full of holes and leaks. So better not to risk it.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <That's very different from mine.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But let's move on to the next question.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<“Question two: You get on the boat.
There is an animal on it. What animal is it?”>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Hmm... A dragon.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Dragon? So you went for a fantastical creature.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <What was your animal?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <A shark.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <What do these answers tell you?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <The size of the boat apparently corresponds to personal ambitions.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <My ambitions...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Then, how easy it is to get on the boat depends on your personality. If it's easy, you're an open, straightforward person.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <If it's difficult, that means you're an introvert, and you rarely seek help from others.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Your boat was so big you'd need an invitation to get on...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <In other words, I have a difficult personality.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It would seem so.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <And the animals?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That part tells you about how satisfied you are with your daily life.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <If it's a dog, cat, or some other pet, it means you're generally happy.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <If it's a rat or other small creature like that, you're slightly dissatisfied. A cow, horse or other farm animal means you're only pretending to be satisfied.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <A large, dangerous animal like a lion means you're very unhappy and at the end of your tether...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Your shark and my dragon would fall into that category.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <You know, Yuki...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <If you feel like you can't take it anymore, it's okay for you to come to us for help.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Actually, you absolutely must come to us.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Okay...>
